documentation: Researched hardware specifications for each catalogued radio, keyed vendor|model exactly as radio-catalog.json spells it. Hand-maintained: no CHIRP driver knows a radio's battery, charging, or feature set, so this cannot be generated. Figures come from manufacturer spec sheets, manuals and reputable retailers (see sources). null means not established and renders nothing; never guess. An entry with no sources renders nothing at all. caveat is shown under the table and carries the qualifiers a reader needs (which regional or hardware version the figures describe); note is the maintainer's research log and is never rendered. formFactor is handheld, portable (battery-carrying field sets like the FT-817), mobile, base or receiver. charging holds usb-c, usb, cradle or external ([] for radios without a battery). powerW is watts; txMHz and rxMHz are [low, high] MHz ranges of the stock radio, which can be narrower than the driver's. dualReceive means two simultaneous receivers, not dual watch. aprs, gps and bluetoothProgramming may be "optional" when an add-on unit supplies them. scripts/build-model-pages.mjs turns these into a hardware table on each model page.
